display.purpose: Every screen's h1 — Manrope, capped 30ch, balanced wrap.

metric.purpose: The one big countable number on a screen (accuracy %, streak count) — Manrope, tabular-nums.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy and subtitle lines — Inter, capped ~52ch.

label.purpose: Small-caps kicker above a card's content — Inter, Signal Blue.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Default near-invisible shadow on cards and inputs at rest.

shadows.name: tile-lift
shadows.purpose: Landing feature tile hover state, paired with lift+scale transform.

shadows.name: glow-badge
shadows.purpose: Small circular icon badge centered inside a stat-tile ring.

motion.name: ease-overshoot
motion.purpose: Pop-in feel for feedback reveals and landing tile entrance — used sparingly, not a general animation default.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most-wanted action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 46px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 14px; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid transparent; white-space: nowrap; background: #2F6FF5; color: #FFFFFF; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, #2F6FF5 90%, black 6%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, #2F6FF5 20%, transparent); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A lower-emphasis action beside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 46px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 14px; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; background: #EEF3FC; color: #16233F; border: 1px solid #E1E7F5; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, #EEF3FC 75%, #16233F 6%); }

components.name: Card
components.description: The default content container — flat at rest, hairline border only.
components.html:
First-guess accuracy
Correct on first guess, across 12 attempts.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E1E7F5; border-radius: 20px; padding: 26px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px hsl(220 45% 25% / 0.05); } .ds-card-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #2F6FF5; display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-text { font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.6; color: #16233F; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A single-line or multi-line field with a Signal Blue focus glow.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #E1E7F5; background: #FFFFFF; color: #16233F; border-radius: 14px; padding: 14px 16px; font-size: 15px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px hsl(220 45% 25% / 0.05); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6B7A99; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #2F6FF5; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, #2F6FF5 20%, transparent); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: A pill-shaped toggle group; the selected option fills Deep Console Navy.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; background: #EEF3FC; border-radius: 999px; gap: 2px; } .ds-segmented button { border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 8px 15px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #6B7A99; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segmented button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #13294B; color: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px hsl(220 45% 25% / 0.12); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A small pill communicating outcome purely through color — matched/missed/in-progress.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 999px; width: fit-content; } .ds-badge-matched { background: #E6F8EF; color: #2FBE7A; } .ds-badge-missed { background: #EEF3FC; color: #6B7A99; }

components.name: Outline Panel Link
components.description: Home dashboard's big entry tiles — lifts and warms its border on hover.
components.html:
What are we solving today?

A messy client ask in, a sharp AI approach out.
components.css: .ds-panel-link { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 20px; padding: 30px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #16233F; border: 1px solid #E1E7F5; transition: transform 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-panel-link:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: color-mix(in oklch, #2F6FF5 45%, #E1E7F5); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px -10px hsl(220 45% 25% / 0.3); } .ds-panel-link h2 { margin-top: 7px; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; } .ds-panel-link p { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 14px; color: #6B7A99; }

components.name: Ring Stat Tile
components.description: Signature component: a circular progress ring with a colored icon badge, showing a percentage. Same ring math as the quiz countdown timer, at a smaller size.
components.html:
●
First-guess accuracy
75%
components.css: .ds-stat-tile { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; border-radius: 20px; padding: 22px; background: linear-gradient(155deg, color-mix(in oklch, #2F6FF5 10%, #FFFFFF), #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, #2F6FF5 24%, #E1E7F5); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px hsl(220 45% 25% / 0.05); } .ds-stat-ring { position: relative; width: 68px; height: 68px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-stat-ring svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; transform: rotate(-90deg); } .ds-ring-track { fill: none; stroke-width: 9; stroke: color-mix(in oklch, #2F6FF5 18%, #E1E7F5); } .ds-ring-progress { fill: none; stroke-width: 9; stroke-linecap: round; stroke: #2F6FF5; transition: stroke-dashoffset 0.5s ease; } .ds-ring-icon { position: absolute; inset: 0; margin: auto; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 999px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #fff; background: #2F6FF5; font-size: 14px; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px -2px hsl(220 45% 25% / 0.35); } .ds-metric { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #16233F; }

components.name: Quiz Timer Ring
components.description: Signature component: a 132px circular countdown with a navy clock face at center, used on quiz screens.
components.css: .ds-quiz-ring { position: relative; width: 132px; height: 132px; border-radius: 999px; border: 0; background: color-mix(in oklch, #2F6FF5 8%, #FFFFFF); cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-quiz-ring-svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; transform: rotate(-90deg); } .ds-quiz-ring-track { fill: none; stroke: color-mix(in oklch, #2F6FF5 22%, #E1E7F5); stroke-width: 10; } .ds-quiz-ring-progress { fill: none; stroke: #2F6FF5; stroke-width: 10; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-quiz-ring-num { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 26px; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #16233F; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
Vantage is where a consultant makes a call — not a game, not a toy. The visual system reads like an instrument panel built for confident decisions under time pressure: a deep navy control surface, one disciplined signal-blue accent, flat and precise rather than soft and decorative. Every screen is built around the same act — guess, then reveal — so the interface stays quiet and gets out of the way of that moment.
The palette runs in two registers: a light "New Blue" mode (soft blue-white canvas, white cards, navy ink) for daytime work, and a dark "Black & Blue" mode (true black canvas, near-black cards, the same signal blue turned up in luminance) for a genuine console-at-night feel. Both are locked and share the same structural rules — only the values change.
Confirmed anti-reference: not a playful, cartoonish consumer app. Vantage has streaks and quizzes, but they're instrumentation for judgment-building, not gamified decoration — no mascots, no candy colors, no bounce for its own sake.
keyCharacteristics: One disciplined accent color (Signal Blue) against a navy/white console structure
Flat by design — depth comes from color and tonal contrast, not shadow layering
Manrope for anything the eye should land on first (headings, metrics); Inter for everything read in full sentences
Pill shapes for state and status (segmented controls, badges, chips); rectangular radii for containers and inputs

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is the only color used to mean 'act on this.' Everything else in the palette is structural (navy, neutral) or purely semantic status (success/destructive) — never decorative color for its own sake.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any number that updates or is compared against another number (metrics, timers, history timestamps) uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums — digits never reflow the layout as they change.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat by default. A stronger shadow appears only as a direct response to hover/interaction state, never as ambient decoration on a static element.

rules.name: The Pill-Means-State Rule
rules.body: If a border-radius: 999px is used, the element is communicating a mode, status, or selectable state (segmented control, badge, chip, tag). Containers and static content never use a full pill radius.

dos: Do keep Signal Blue rare — it should mean 'the answer' or 'act here,' not 'a nice color to add.'
Do use Deep Console Navy for the one 'selected/active' state that Signal Blue doesn't already own (segmented controls).
Do use tabular-nums on every metric, timer, and comparable number.
Do keep shadows near-invisible at rest; let hover states carry the only real lift.
Do pair Manrope (headings/metrics) with Inter (body) — never introduce a third typeface.
donts: Don't add a second accent color. If something needs to stand out, use Signal Blue, Console Navy, or a semantic status color — not a new hue.
Don't design toward a playful/cartoonish consumer-app look, even for streak or quiz features — those are judgment-building instrumentation, not gamified decoration.
Don't default to generic AI-slop gradient blobs or purple/violet AI branding — this palette is blue/navy on purpose, not a stand-in for 'AI product colors.'
Don't add ambient shadow or glow to a static element — motion/glow is reserved for meaningful state (live recording, a correct-answer pop, the pro-tip bulb).
